note: Pre-vetted real stock photos, organized by niche. Pick from here for new site builds instead of dispatching fetch-stock-photo.yml fresh - every photo listed here has already been visually confirmed to show the correct, relevant subject (no AI-generated people, no wrong-subject mismatches). Track 'usedBy' as you assign a photo to a new site, and avoid handing the exact same photo to two sites that will likely be reviewed back-to-back or compete in the same niche+area. If a niche's library runs thin or none of the existing photos fit a specific flaw/angle you need, fetch fresh via fetch-stock-photo.yml as before, visually verify it, THEN copy the good result into this library (new subfolder/file, add a manifest entry) so it's reusable next time instead of being a one-off.
